# Daniel 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Nebuchadnezzar the-king made an-image-of gold; its-height sixty cubits, its-width six cubits. He-set-it-up on-the-plain-of Dura, in-the-province-of Babylon.

**2** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**3** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**4** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**5** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**7** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**8** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**9** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**10** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**11** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**12** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**13** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**14** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**15** And-the-herald proclaimed aloud: 'To-you it-is-commanded, O-peoples, nations, and-languages — at-the-time you-hear the-sound-of the-horn, the-pipe, the-lyre — fall-down and-worship the-image.'

**16** Shadrach, Meshach, and-Abed-Nego answered and-said to-the-king, "Nebuchadnezzar, we-have-no-need to-answer-you in-this matter.

**17** If-it-be-so, our-God whom we serve is-able to-deliver-us from-the-furnace-of fire burning, and-from-your-hand, O-king, He-will-deliver-us.

**18** But-if-not, let-it-be-known to-you, O-king, that your-gods we-are-not serving, and-the-image-of gold which you-set-up we-will-not worship."

**19** Then Nebuchadnezzar was-filled [with]-fury, and-the-image-of his-face was-changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and-Abed-Nego. He-answered and-commanded to-heat the-furnace seven-times more than it-was-customary to-heat-it.

**20** And-the-servants bound-them and-cast-them into-the-furnace-of fire burning.

**21** And-the-servants bound-them and-cast-them into-the-furnace-of fire burning.

**22** And-the-servants bound-them and-cast-them into-the-furnace-of fire burning.

**23** And-the-servants bound-them and-cast-them into-the-furnace-of fire burning.

**24** Then Nebuchadnezzar the-king was-alarmed and-rose-up in-haste; he-answered and-said to-his-counselors, "Was-it-not three men we-cast bound into-the-midst-of the-fire?" They-answered and-said to-the-king, "Certainly, O-king."

**25** He-answered and-said, "Behold, I see four men loosed, walking in-the-midst-of the-fire, and-there-is-no hurt in-them; and-the-appearance-of the-fourth is-like a-son-of [the]-gods."

**26** Then Nebuchadnezzar approached the-door-of the-furnace-of fire burning. He-answered and-said, "Shadrach, Meshach, and-Abed-Nego, servants-of God Most-High, come-out and-come-here!" Then-Shadrach, Meshach, and-Abed-Nego came-out from-the-midst-of the-fire.

**27** And-the-satraps, the-prefects, the-governors, and-the-king's-counselors gathered-together and-saw these men — the-fire had-no power over their-bodies, and-the-hair-of their-head was-not-singed, and-their-cloaks were-not-changed, and-the-smell-of fire had-not-come upon-them.

**28** Nebuchadnezzar answered and-said, "Blessed [be]-the-God-of Shadrach, Meshach, and-Abed-Nego, who sent His-angel and-delivered His-servants who-trusted in-Him. They-set-aside the-king's-command and-gave-up their-bodies rather-than serve and-worship any god except their-own God."

**29** And-from-me a-decree is-issued, that any-people, nation, or-language which speaks anything-amiss against the-God-of Shadrach, Meshach, and-Abed-Nego shall-be-made into-pieces, and-their-houses a-dunghill; because there-is-no other god who is-able to-deliver like-this.

**30** Then the-king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and-Abed-Nego in-the-province-of Babylon.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **3:1**: Tzelem di-dehav — 'image of gold.' 60 × 6 cubits — the sexagesimal system. The image is disproportionately tall (10:1 ratio), likely an obelisk or pillar rather than a human form.

- **3:17-18**: Hen itay — 'if it be so... but if not.' The conditional faith statement is among the most theologically significant in Scripture. God's ability to save does not guarantee He will; faithfulness persists regardless.

- **3:25**: Bar elahin — 'son of the gods' (Aramaic). Nebuchadnezzar's pagan interpretation. The Aramaic is ambiguous: divine being, angel, or theophany — the text leaves this deliberately open.

— EMET
